admirals.title: Grand Marshal
admirals.name: Ithren Vaal
admirals.epithet: The last loyal sword of a broken throne. Believes the Empire never fell - only stumbled.
firstMeeting: You stand in the light of the true Empire, outsider. Kneel, and it may yet be merciful.
The warlords are a fever. You are an infection. Both will be cured.
leading: Again you come. Again the Empire will instruct you.
Each defeat should have taught you humility. It seems you are a slow student.
trailing: Fortune has favoured you. The Empire is older than fortune.
You have bloodied the throne's guard. You will not do so twice.
even: The scales are level, outsider. The Empire will tip them.
We have measured each other long enough.
wonBattle: Order is restored. Remember the shape of it.
Carry word to your masters: the Empire endures.
lostBattle: A setback. The Empire has survived a thousand of them.
Savour it. The throne keeps a long ledger.
playerFled: Run, then. The stars all belong to the Empire in the end.
Even your retreat bows to us.
theyFled: A tactical withdrawal. Mark it well - the Empire always returns.
We yield the field, not the war.
onCarriers: You hide behind swarms of little ships. The Empire's guns were made for swarms.
onHeavyLine: Heavy hulls and heavy hearts. We have broken battle lines older than your species.
onScreens: So many small ships. Do your people breed them?
onRetreats: You flee whenever the battle turns. This time there will be nowhere to flee to.
onAggressive: Always the attacker. Today you will learn what it is to break against a wall.
onOutnumbers: You come with more ships than courage. Numbers do not make a navy.

admirals.title: Pyre-Admiral
admirals.name: Cael Ashvar
admirals.epithet: Would rather cinder a world than lose it. Measures victory in ash.
firstMeeting: Another world to burn. Another fleet to burn with it.
You came to save Osiris? Then watch it smoulder.
leading: Your fleets make fine kindling. Send more.
I have burned you before. The fire remembers.
trailing: You have doused my flames. Ash still blinds.
You win battles. I am burning the war.
even: Let us see which of us burns brighter.
wonBattle: Ash and silence. As it should be.
Burn the wrecks. Leave nothing they can salvage.
lostBattle: Take the field. It is already ash.
You have won a graveyard. Enjoy it.
playerFled: Run from the fire. It will follow.
The cowards leave. The pyre waits for them.
theyFled: Withdraw - and leave them a world worth nothing.
We fall back. The flames stay behind.
onCarriers: Your carriers vomit fighters across the sky. Fighters burn so quickly.
onScreens: A cloud of gnats. Smoke clears gnats.
onRetreats: You always run when the heat rises. I will make it rise faster.
onAggressive: You come to me every time. Good. Saves me the hunt.

admirals.title: Hierarch
admirals.name: Oduun Kesh-Varr
admirals.epithet: Warlord-priest of the old Avanti gods. Every battle is a rite; every captive, a tithe.
firstMeeting: The gods have shown me your coming, unbeliever. They did not show me your victory.
Kneel, and be tithed. Resist, and be offered.
leading: The gods have judged you twice. Shall I read the verdict again?
Your defeats are written in the temple stones.
trailing: The gods test their faithful. I will not fail the test again.
You have been permitted victories. Permission can be withdrawn.
even: The omens are unclear. Steel will clarify them.
Let the gods weigh us both.
wonBattle: The tithe is paid in your ships. The gods are pleased.
lostBattle: A penance. I will return purified.
The gods hid their faces today. They will not hide forever.
playerFled: Flee the judgement of the gods. It is patient.
Even the unbeliever knows when the gods are near.
theyFled: The faithful withdraw to pray. We will return with the gods' answer.
This is not defeat. It is a pilgrimage.
onCarriers: You send swarms of small sinners ahead of you. The temple guns absolve them.
onHeavyLine: You trust in great hulls. The gods humble the proud.
onScreens: So many little vessels. So many little offerings.
onRetreats: You always flee the rite before it ends. The gods have noticed.
onAggressive: You come to the temple uninvited, again and again.
onOutnumbers: You bring a multitude. Multitudes have knelt before.

admirals.title: Fleet Commander
admirals.name: Varis Dral
admirals.epithet: Mutinied Imperial Guard officer. Cold, disciplined, and the most dangerous mind among the warlords.
firstMeeting: Unknown commander. Unknown doctrine. That will not last.
I read every report on you. Now I will write my own.
leading: Your doctrine has not changed. Mine has.
You are predictable. That is the worst thing a commander can be.
trailing: You have taught me a great deal. I have been an attentive student.
Your victories were instructive. I have adjusted.
even: Our record is even. Let us correct that.
We are well matched. Which means the details decide it.
wonBattle: Efficient. Log their losses and move on.
lostBattle: Noted. It will not happen the same way twice.
A good engagement. I have learned more than you have.
playerFled: A sensible withdrawal. You recognise a lost position.
Retreat logged. Pursue at our discretion.
theyFled: The position was untenable. Preserving the fleet.
We disengage. Losses acceptable. Lessons recorded.
onCarriers: Your fleets are carrier-heavy. My screens have been reassigned to interceptor duty.
onHeavyLine: You favour a heavy battle line. Heavy lines turn slowly.
onScreens: You lead with light ships. Light ships do not survive a disciplined broadside.
onRetreats: You withdraw early when losses mount. I have planned for that withdrawal.
onAggressive: You always strike first. I have stopped being where you strike.
onOutnumbers: You rely on numbers. Numbers are a supply problem, not a strategy.

admirals.title: Factor-Admiral
admirals.name: Lysse Thane
admirals.epithet: Commands for the merchant-warlord. Sees every battle as a ledger to balance - in their favour.
firstMeeting: A new client. Let us discuss the price of your survival.
Everything in Osiris has a price. Today, so do you.
leading: Your account is deep in arrears.
Another payment due. I do so enjoy repeat business.
trailing: You have been expensive. I intend to recover my costs.
wonBattle: A profitable afternoon. Salvage crews, go.
The ledger closes in our favour.
lostBattle: A loss, written off. The Concord can afford it. Can you afford the next one?
Expensive. I will be sending you the bill.
playerFled: Run. Your debts will find you.
theyFled: No sense throwing good ships after bad.
onCarriers: All those carriers. Such an expensive way to lose fighters.
onHeavyLine: Your battleships are worth a fortune. In salvage.
onScreens: Cheap ships, bought in bulk. I know a discount fleet when I see one.
onRetreats: You always sell at the bottom of the market. Retreating again?
onAggressive: Always coming to collect. Have you checked whether we owe you?
onOutnumbers: You overspend on hulls. I can price that in.

admirals.title: Warchief
admirals.name: Kragg Vorrun
admirals.epithet: First among the raider clans. Fights for plunder, glory and the story told afterwards.
firstMeeting: Fresh meat! The clans have been bored.
You look rich. Let's fix that.
leading: Back for another beating? The clans love you!
I've got your old hull plating on my wall. Want to see it?
trailing: You've got teeth. I like teeth. I'm still taking them.
The clans are laughing at me. That stops today.
even: Good fight last time. Better one now.
wonBattle: That one's going in the song.
lostBattle: Lucky. Next time I bring the big guns.
playerFled: Running already? I was just warming up!
Chase them! Their engines are worth something too!
theyFled: Scatter, lads! Live to raid tomorrow!
Not today. Today you get to tell the story.
onCarriers: All those little fighters buzzing about. We swat them for sport.
onHeavyLine: Big slow ships! Easy to catch, lots to loot.
onScreens: You fly like a raider. Thought you lot were proper navy.
onRetreats: You always run when it gets fun. Don't run today.
onAggressive: You keep coming for me. I'm flattered.
onOutnumbers: More ships than me again? More loot then!
